title: Stable Canonical Rules for Intuitionistic Modal Logics
summary: This paper develops stable canonical rules for intuitionistic modal logics, which were first introduced for superintuitionistic logics and transitive nor mal modal logics in [1] and [2] respectively. We first prove that every in tuitionistic modal multi-conclusion consequence relation is axiomatizable by stable canonical rules. This allows us to assume, without loss of generality, that rules considered by us are stable canonical ones. The idea turns out to be useful.
